title: Build Process, Types, and Input Phase Assessment
description: Comprehensive phase-end assessment covering all lessons in Build Process, Types, and Input.

questions.prompt: Which is the safest beginner application of preprocessing?

options.text: use headers for declarations and include guards
preprocessing handles directives before compilation
macros do textual substitution without type checking
The language automatically repairs the issue

questions.explanation: use headers for declarations and include guards. Verify with strict warnings, a minimal program, and observable output.

questions.prompt: Which is the safest beginner application of compiler warnings?

options.text: enable Wall Wextra and Wpedantic
warnings identify suspicious but translatable code
ignoring warnings can leave real defects

questions.explanation: enable Wall Wextra and Wpedantic. Verify with strict warnings, a minimal program, and observable output.

questions.prompt: Which is the safest beginner application of linking?

questions.prompt: Which is the safest beginner application of integer division?
